feedback: Written before this candidate has raced. Iteration 5 held the iteration 4 geometry and lowered base_speed to 1.2. Oval line loss stayed at 0, but S-bend and slalom each still logged about 1 event with max_error near 0.062 to 0.066 m, so bend speed alone did not clear the losses. Iteration 1 (kp 3.0) raised oscillation to 0.186, while iteration 2 (kp 2.5, kd 0.2) lowered it, so this iteration tests a modest rise in kp with more damping. Geometry is unchanged and is the Builder's current design. Decide the next geometry from the next race. If S-bend and slalom line_loss_events are still 1 with geometry fixed, the loss is not geometric, so do not edit geometry; report where on the course it starts. If line_loss_events is 0 on all three tracks but max_error still approaches 0.06 m, the next geometry step is wheel_track 0.12 m for more differential turn authority. If runs complete but completion_time exceeds 2.5 s, test wheel_radius 0.035 m for more top speed.

If line_loss_events stays at 1 on the S-bend or slalom, keep the geometry fixed. Iterations 3 to 6 at 0.6 and 0.7 kg, and iteration 5 at base_speed 1.2, show no geometry-side clearing, so do not change mass or span again.
Only if runs complete and completion_time exceeds 2.5 s, set wheel_radius to 0.035 m. Progress is currently 0.11 to 0.17, so runs must first reach the finish before top speed matters.
